storage.boundary: sizeof the existing three global key arrays and two thread-local arrays only; excludes mutex/TLS machinery, process RSS and OS allocation commitment

negative_controls.name: global-read-lock
negative_controls.assertion: pthread keys: local read proceeds while key registry is locked

negative_controls.name: stale-generation
negative_controls.assertion: pthread keys: another thread sees empty replacement

negative_controls.name: deleted-publication
negative_controls.assertion: pthread keys: deleted key reads empty

negative_controls.name: generation-wrap
negative_controls.assertion: pthread keys: exhausted generation retires without wrap

negative_controls.name: obsolete-destructor
negative_controls.assertion: pthread keys: obsolete values never reach replacement destructor

functional.local_limit: Actual extracted key/exit source and real host pthread TLS; Windows ThreadRecord boundary is supplied.

main_integration.ci_only_change: append --negative-controls to existing required pthread-key contract step

remaining_limits: Full Windows linking/execution, actual exported native/ART/ELF fixture and app performance remain remote CI work.
No application startup, whole-runtime CPU, process RSS or universal speedup claim.
The atomic snapshot does not extend caller value, destructor or loaded-module lifetime.
Cold one-read CPU/wall regressions and all earlier adverse controls remain disclosed.
